messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Triggered PD#14297: inference-hotpath queue backlog (P1). page fired to on-call at 2026-03-17T10:02:03Z
pagerduty: Alert routed to alice.oncall (primary) and bob.sre (secondary)
alice.oncall: ack — I'm on it, pulling dashboards and ingress queue metrics now :eyes:
bob.sre: ack — standing by, will pull autoscaler/controller logs
alice.oncall: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inq?panel=queue_length  queue length ~212k, growth +22% over 5m, tail latency ~2800ms, errors 1.1% -> estimated affected customers: ~14 (us-east1 mostly)
carol-runtime: looking at runtime logs, autoscaler reports repeated provisioning failures: "createInstance: quotaExceeded: All cores quota exhausted for region us-east1". also seeing controller sync lag ~6m
bob.sre: confirmed in controller logs: ``ERROR controller: scale request failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'CPUS' exceeded, quotaExceeded``. kube-apiserver returning 429 for large batches, scale loop backing off
eva-ml: we can reduce model footprint by switching to quantized model variant for non-tier-1 traffic, reduces memory per worker ~30% — can be rolled in as hotfix routing rule
alice.oncall: short term mitigations proposed: 1) manual scale shared-inference-pool (+12 nodes) 2) request emergency increase for CPUS quota 3) route non-prod & tier-2 traffic to eu-west1 4) fallback to quantized model for staging/low-priority customers. executing 1 and 3 now
ops-bot: manual scale command queued: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-infer-us-east1 --size=+12` — started at 10:08:20Z
frank-support: heads up — support queue showing multiple tickets about slow responses from customers corpA, corpB, corpD. latency >5s for interactive features. drafting status page message now
carol-runtime: initiating model variant rollout: route rule "infer-route: low-priority -> model-quant-v2" applied (canary 10% immediate) — will ramp if stable
bob.sre: also bumping controller concurrency to reduce apiserver 429s: `kubectl patch deployment autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"controller","env":[{"name":"CONCURRENCY","value":"40"}]}]}}}}'` — applied at 10:12:45Z
alice.oncall: monitoring — queue growth has flattened, length down to 138k in 12m, tail latency down to ~900ms. manual instances reported provisioning (8/12 still booting). continuing watch. sending interim PD update
pagerduty: PD#14297 status updated: mitigation in progress, acknowledged by alice.oncall. escalation suspended
frank-support: posted status update draft to status.redwood.com -> "We are investigating increased inference latencies in US-East; mitigations underway. Customers experiencing delays may see improved performance shortly."
alice.oncall: switching to handoff mode — bob.sre, taking long-tail cleanup and postmortem ownership? I'll stay available for questions. planned handoff at 11:20Z :handshake:
bob.sre: ack handoff, I'll own the follow-through and coordinate quota increase with infra contacts. will post runbook items and timeboxed follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: manual scale completed: +12 instances applied, 12 healthy by 10:25:03Z
carol-runtime: quantized variant ramp to 60% for low-priority traffic, memory usage per pod down ~28%, p95 latency reduced further
bob.sre: observed autoscaler reconcile loop catching up; no new quota errors after manual scale but still tracking cloud quota request ticket #QC-9987 for permanent fix
alice.oncall: thanks all — handoff complete. next update in 60m or earlier if anything regress.
